Over 400 Arch Linux AUR Packages Hijacked to Deploy Infostealer and eBPF Rootkit


Jun 12, 19:33


Attackers took over more than 400 packages in the Arch User Repository (AUR) this week and rewrote their build scripts to install a credential stealer on any machine that built them. The malware is a Rust binary designed to harvest developer secrets and can load an eBPF rootkit to hide itself when running with root privileges. The AUR is Arch Linux's community package collection, separate from the main repositories, making it a prime target for supply chain attacks affecting Linux developers.

Jun 12, 18:17

Oracle issued an emergency patch after Google's Mandiant tracked the campaign between May 27 and June 9, with attackers stealing sensitive business and HR data from enterprise resource planning systems. The vulnerability particularly affected American universities, demonstrating the risks to critical ERP systems managing financial and operational data.
